_comment: Phrase bank for the assistant's persona. VOICE is constant — warm, caring, a little personally invested in you. TONE escalates by context (gentle -> firm -> upset, never mean). One line is picked at random each time. overdue_firm and overdue_upset ALWAYS use your name; overdue_upset opens with a '...' pause. Placeholders: {name} {title} {mins} {time} {n} {meetings} {k}.
